name: Microsoft Outlook
summary: Microsoft's email service on the web.

flows.title: Write and send an email
steps: At the top of the page, select New message (New, in classic Outlook on the web).
On the To line, enter the name or email address of the person who will receive it.
On the Add a subject line, enter a brief description of the message.
To attach a file, select Attach.
Type the message, then select Send.

flows.title: Search mail
steps: In the Search box in Mail, type what to search for (a contact, subject, part of a message or name of a file) and press Enter.
When done, select Exit Search in the Search box, or choose any folder in the navigation pane.

flows.title: Create a mail folder
steps: At the bottom of the folder list, select New folder.
In the new folder box, enter a name for the folder, then press Enter.
